title: Collateral Desk Computation — Release Price of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Unit Released After a Total Loss
content:
**Computation.** The release price of a unit of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan released after a total loss is the greater of the settlement amount registered on the request and the product's partial release premium percentage of the unit's share of principal, that share being the principal balance times the unit's pledged value divided by the pledged value of all units still securing the loan, rounded to cents, and the premium amount itself also rounded to cents. The release price so found is limited to the principal balance.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Record it is read from |
|---|---|
| Settlement amount | the amount on the submitted collateral release request naming the destroyed unit's serial number |
| Unit's pledged value | the pledge record of the unit with that serial number |
| Pledged value of all units still securing the loan | the pledged value of every unit pledged to the loan less that of every unit since released |
| Principal balance | the loan record on the release date |
| Partial release premium percentage | the product's figure in the collateral desk schedule |

## How the figures combine

1. The unit's share of principal is the principal balance multiplied by the unit's pledged value and divided by the pledged value of all units still securing the loan, rounded to cents.
2. The premium amount is the unit's share multiplied by the partial release premium percentage and divided by 100, rounded to cents.
3. The release price is the higher of the premium amount and the settlement amount, and never more than the principal balance.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs, New Equipment Loan, premium percentage 110)

- **Premium governs.** Principal 200000.00; destroyed unit pledged at 60000.00; all units still securing the loan pledged at 240000.00. Share: 200000.00 multiplied by 60000.00 and divided by 240000.00, that is 50000.00. Premium amount: 110 percent of 50000.00, that is 55000.00. Settlement 52000.00. Release price: 55000.00.
- **Settlement governs.** Same loan, settlement 58500.00: the release price is 58500.00.
- **Principal limits.** Principal 30000.00, share 30000.00, premium amount 33000.00, settlement 34000.00: the higher figure, 34000.00, is limited to the principal balance, so the release price is 30000.00.
